Hi Mrs./Mx Johnson. 

I thought this is a perfect morning so decided I'd get the mail before coffee! Just walking to the bin for our bags of recycling I was really charme seeing some dahllias coming in to their peak. The ones that are pink look absolutely stunning today. The sun catches their color beautifully as the petals stretch towards it.

Anyway. Thought you could do the neighborly right thing of popping round with some of their clippys for us if you have the extra to spare? They've got quite big rootstock now but still only small flowers so a couple would make all our beds pop this month I'm pretty certain, esp with so sunny weather in forecast.
  
Cheers and enjoy this day. 

Love
Jane [or Your Full Names]
PS - Let me knw when it might suit. Hope
